company_name: Hangzhou Daotian Vacuum Equipment Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in vacuum equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Hangzhou Daotian Vacuum Equipment Co., Ltd. provides essential equipment and services for semiconductor and photovoltaic crystal growth processes. Their offerings include PVD and CVD coating vacuum equipment, catering to manufacturers and research institutions in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: PVD and CVD coating vacuum equipment
Crystal growth furnaces for semiconductor and photovoltaic applications
